videos.script:
The Next.js planner can show a week. Today it learns to change one, and to keep the screen honest while the server works.

{{function}} First a Server Function: an async function in a file marked use server, which a form can call as if it were local. One press, one request, and the page comes back with the change in it.

{{form}} Then a form whose action runs on the server, checks what it was sent, and returns what to say. And a surprise: after the action, React empties the form, even when the answer was an error.

{{pending}} Then the wait. With a slow server, nothing moves for four seconds. useTransition says something is happening, and useOptimistic shows the change before the server confirms it.

{{no}} And last, a server that says no. Thrown, the error takes the whole page. Returned, the button goes back to the truth on its own, and says why.
